test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/409234e4411b7a31ae7f35685fbe9cb2342aabec3178de2df388ef2b9a23e1ca.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 
• The arrow rotates in an anti-clockwise direction in its own position and one by one arrow’s front and last position parts become dark.
 
• A rectangular rotates in a clockwise direction and also rotates a clockwise direction in a box.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bc5e786b1192643d3080248235f47b575477ac0fee44481b99b70db8cddcfa8.png] 

 
• Final series is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bc5e786b1192643d3080248235f47b575477ac0fee44481b99b70db8cddcfa8.png] 

Hence, **‘option 2’** is the correct answer.
